title: Inadequate User Authentication
description: The homeowner may use weak passwords or fail to enable two-factor authentication, making their account vulnerable to unauthorized access.

title: Data Retention and Disposal Issues
description: The Home Hub may retain personal data longer than necessary or fail to securely delete data, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Data transmitted from the homeowner to the Home Hub may be intercepted by malicious actors if not properly encrypted, leading to privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub
description: A guest user may share the temporary access code with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to unlock the front door without permission.

title: Insecure Storage of Access Codes
description: The Home Hub may store the temporary access codes insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or retrieval by malicious actors.

title: Network Eavesdropping
description: The temporary access code could be intercepted during transmission if the communication channel is not secured, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensor Data
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently expose sensitive motion/door/sensor event data to unauthorized users or devices during the writing process to the local event log.

title: Data Retention and Access Control Issues
description: The Local Event Log may retain sensitive event data longer than necessary, leading to potential unauthorized access or misuse of the data.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data being written from the Home Hub to the Local Event Log could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive event information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Camera Clips
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently share recorded camera clips with unauthorized users due to misconfiguration or lack of proper authentication mechanisms.

title: Data Interception During Upload
description: Recorded camera clips may be intercepted during the upload process to the cloud, exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Clips
description: The cloud video storage may not implement adequate security measures, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches of stored camera clips.

title: Unintended Data Retention
description: The cloud service may retain uploaded camera clips longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of personal data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Motion Alerts
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently share motion alerts with unauthorized parties due to misconfiguration or lack of proper authentication mechanisms.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The real-time motion alert could be intercepted during transmission from the Home Hub to the Mobile App Backend, leading to potential unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling by Mobile App Backend
description: The Mobile App Backend may store or process the motion alerts in a way that does not comply with privacy regulations, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Notification Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive information about the homeowner through the notification, allowing unauthorized parties to access this data.

title: Interception of Notification Data
description: The motion-detected notification could be intercepted during transmission, allowing attackers to gain insights into the homeowner's activities or presence.

title: Insecure Handling of Notification Data
description: The homeowner may not handle the notification securely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information if the device is lost or compromised.

title: Inadequate Anonymization
description: The aggregated device-usage analytics may still contain identifiable information that could be used to re-identify individual users, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Vendor
description: The cloud analytics vendor may misuse the aggregated data for purposes not agreed upon, such as selling it to third parties or using it for targeted advertising.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of aggregated analytics to the cloud analytics vendor, potentially exposing sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Clips
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the stored video clips in the cloud storage, leading to potential privacy violations for the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Mobile App Backend
description: The mobile app backend may mishandle the retrieved video clips, leading to exposure of sensitive information or unauthorized sharing.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Metadata or other information about the video clips may be leaked during transmission from the cloud storage to the mobile app backend, potentially revealing user behavior or preferences.
